008package paint.ui.dialogs.project;
009
010import javax.swing.*;
011import javax.swing.border.EmptyBorder;
012import javax.swing.event.DocumentEvent;
013import java.awt.*;
014import java.awt.event.ActionEvent;
015import java.io.File;
016import java.nio.file.Path;
017import java.util.function.Consumer;
018
019import static paint.ui.dialogs.ProjectDialog.DialogMode;
020
021/**
022 * Panel allowing users to select the Project Root and Images Root directories.
023 * <p>
024 * The panel exposes browse buttons, text fields, and callback hooks. It notifies
025 * listeners when the text changes or when browse actions complete.
026 */
027public class ProjectPathsPanel {
028
029    private final JPanel     panel = new JPanel(new GridBagLayout());  // The root UI panel containing the layout.
030    private final JTextField projectRootField;                         // Text field for the project root directory.
031    private final JTextField imagesRootField;                          // Text field for the images root directory
032    private final JButton    browseProjectBtn;                         // Browse button for project root.
033    private final JButton    browseImagesBtn;                          // Browse button for images root.
034
035    /**
036     * Runnable invoked when either root changes.
037     */
038    private Runnable rootsChanged = () -> {
039    };
040
041    /**
042     * Consumer invoked when a project directory is chosen via the browse dialog.
043     */
044    private Consumer<File> onProjectChosen = f -> {
045    };
046
047    /**
048     * Consumer invoked when an images directory is chosen via the browse dialog.
049     */
050    private Consumer<File> onImagesChosen = f -> {
051    };
052
053    /**
054     * Constructs the UI panel, initializes fields, and wires callbacks.
055     *
056     * @param mode           dialog mode (affects Images Root field behavior)
057     * @param initialProject initial project directory to display
058     */
059    public ProjectPathsPanel(DialogMode mode, Path initialProject) {
060        panel.setBorder(new EmptyBorder(10, 10, 10, 10));
061        final GridBagConstraints gbc = new GridBagConstraints();
062        gbc.insets  = new Insets(5, 5, 5, 5);
063        gbc.anchor  = GridBagConstraints.WEST;
064        gbc.fill    = GridBagConstraints.HORIZONTAL;
065        gbc.weightx = 1.0;
066
067        final Dimension labelSize = new Dimension(200, 20);
068        int row = 0;
069
070        // Project Root label
071        JLabel lblProject = new JLabel("Project Root");
072        lblProject.setPreferredSize(labelSize);
073
074        gbc.gridx   = 0;
075        gbc.gridy   = row;
076        gbc.weightx = 0;
077        gbc.fill    = GridBagConstraints.NONE;
078        panel.add(lblProject, gbc);
079
080        // Text field for project root
081        projectRootField = new JTextField(initialProject != null ? initialProject.toString() : System.getProperty("user.home"), 32);
082        gbc.gridx        = 1;
083        gbc.weightx      = 1.0;
084        gbc.fill         = GridBagConstraints.HORIZONTAL;
085        panel.add(projectRootField, gbc);
086
087        // Browse project button
088        browseProjectBtn = new JButton("Browse...");
089        gbc.gridx        = 2;
090        gbc.weightx      = 0;
091        gbc.fill         = GridBagConstraints.NONE;
092        panel.add(browseProjectBtn, gbc);
093
094        row++;
095
096        // Images Root label
097        JLabel lblImages = new JLabel("Images Root");
098        lblImages.setPreferredSize(labelSize);
099
100        gbc.gridx   = 0;
101        gbc.gridy   = row;
102        gbc.weightx = 0;
103        gbc.fill    = GridBagConstraints.NONE;
104        panel.add(lblImages, gbc);
105
106        // Load saved Images Root
107        String savedImagesRoot = paint.shared.utils.PaintPrefs.getString(
108                "Path",
109                "Images Root",
110                System.getProperty("user.home")
111        );
112
113        // Text field for images root
114        imagesRootField = new JTextField(savedImagesRoot, 32);
115        gbc.gridx       = 1;
116        gbc.weightx     = 1.0;
117        gbc.fill        = GridBagConstraints.HORIZONTAL;
118        panel.add(imagesRootField, gbc);
119
120        // Browse images button
121        browseImagesBtn = new JButton("Browse...");
122        gbc.gridx       = 2;
123        gbc.weightx     = 0;
124        gbc.fill        = GridBagConstraints.NONE;
125        panel.add(browseImagesBtn, gbc);
126
127        // Browse action for project root
128        browseProjectBtn.addActionListener(this::browseProjectRoot);
129
130        // Browse action for images root
131        browseImagesBtn.addActionListener(this::browseImagesRoot);
132
133        // Notify when text fields change
134        projectRootField.getDocument().addDocumentListener((SimpleDocumentListener) this::onTextChanged);
135        imagesRootField.getDocument().addDocumentListener((SimpleDocumentListener) this::onTextChanged);
136
137        // GENERATE_SQUARES mode: disable Images Root controls
138        if (mode == DialogMode.GENERATE_SQUARES) {
139            imagesRootField.setEnabled(false);
140            imagesRootField.setBackground(UIManager.getColor("Panel.background"));
141            imagesRootField.setForeground(Color.GRAY);
142            imagesRootField.setFocusable(false);
143            browseImagesBtn.setEnabled(false);
144        }
145    }
146
147    /**
148     * @return the root Swing component
149     */
150    public JPanel component() {
151        return panel;
152    }
153
154    /**
155     * @return the project root path as text
156     */
157    public String projectRootText() {
158        return projectRootField.getText().trim();
159    }
160
161    /**
162     * @return the images root path as text
163     */
164    public String imagesRootText() {
165        return imagesRootField.getText().trim();
166    }
167
168    /**
169     * @return true if the project root path points to a directory
170     */
171    public boolean isProjectRootValid() {
172        return new File(projectRootText()).isDirectory();
173    }
174
175    /**
176     * Enables or disables UI fields depending on dialog mode.
177     */
178    public void setEnabled(boolean enabled, DialogMode mode) {
179        // Project root always follows enabled state
180        projectRootField.setEnabled(enabled);
181        browseProjectBtn.setEnabled(enabled);
182
183        if (mode == DialogMode.GENERATE_SQUARES) {
184            // Only this mode disables images root
185            imagesRootField.setEnabled(false);
186            browseImagesBtn.setEnabled(false);
187        } else {
188            // TRACKMATE and VIEWER
189            imagesRootField.setEnabled(enabled);
190            browseImagesBtn.setEnabled(enabled);
191        }
192    }
193
194    /**
195     * Update the project root text field when changed externally.
196     */
197    public void onProjectRootChanged(Path newRoot) {
198        if (newRoot != null) {
199            projectRootField.setText(newRoot.toString());
200        }
201    }
202
203    /**
204     * Assign callback for general root changes.
205     */
206    public void onRootsChanged(Runnable r) {
207        this.rootsChanged = (r != null ? r : () -> {
208        });
209    }
210
211    /**
212     * Assign callback specifically for project directory browsing.
213     */
214    public void onBrowseProject(Consumer<File> c) {
215        this.onProjectChosen = (c != null ? c : f -> {
216        });
217    }
218
219    /**
220     * Assign callback specifically for images directory browsing.
221     */
222    public void onBrowseImages(Consumer<File> c) {
223        this.onImagesChosen = (c != null ? c : f -> {
224        });
225    }
226
227    /**
228     * Invoked when text changes in either root field; triggers the rootsChanged callback.
229     */
230    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
231    private void onTextChanged(DocumentEvent e) {
232        rootsChanged.run();
233    }
234
235    /**
236     * Returns the value if it is a valid directory; otherwise returns the user's home directory.
237     */
238    private static String valueOrHome(String s) {
239        if (s == null || s.trim().isEmpty()) {
240            return System.getProperty("user.home");
241        }
242        File f = new File(s.trim());
243        return f.isDirectory() ? f.getAbsolutePath() : System.getProperty("user.home");
244    }
245
246    /** Handles the Browse action for the Project Root. */
247    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
248    private void browseProjectRoot(ActionEvent e) {
249        File dir = DirectoryChooser.chooseDirectory(panel, "Project Root", valueOrHome(projectRootField.getText()));
250        if (dir != null && dir.isDirectory()) {
251            projectRootField.setText(dir.getAbsolutePath());
252            onProjectChosen.accept(dir);
253        }
254    }
255
256    /** Handles the Browse action for the Images Root. */
257    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
258    private void browseImagesRoot(ActionEvent e) {
259        File dir = DirectoryChooser.chooseDirectory(panel, "Images Root", valueOrHome(imagesRootField.getText()));
260        if (dir != null && dir.isDirectory()) {
261            imagesRootField.setText(dir.getAbsolutePath());
262            onImagesChosen.accept(dir);
263        }
264    }
265
266
267}
